name: Nadine Alocada
message: With Intermed Language Institute, we learn German not only with our hearts, but with our souls too! It is not an old-school learning method, it is like placing yourself in Germany while your books, teachers and assignments will walk you through it.

name: Frances Dawn Lacia
message: As a nurse, it was easier for me to learn B2-Pflege because all the medical terms we know are incorporated in our lessons in German. It was faster to absorb since we could relate to them. I know that when I start work as I nurse in Germany, I will not be afraid to adjust myself quickly.

name: Royce Ann Montoro
message: Our teachers are very inspiring and open-minded. They give us free tips on how to adjust ourselves to different cultures in Germany. We always look forward to our lessons everyday!

name: Karl Victor Solito
message: Enrolling in this German Class is like enrolling in a Drama Class as well! We have a lot of role-playing that enable us to learn to speak freely and be inventive on how to express ourselves. I never thought learning German could be this fun!

name: Astrid Agpalza
message: I only started learning B2 with Intermed. But the past 10 weeks although quite stressful, has helped me pass the interview with my employer with flying colors! Knowing all these medical terms in German, and answering their questions with confidence ended the interview with words from my employer, "See you soon in Germany"!

name: Louise Colona
message: Hallo, wie geht's? This is the first German sentence I know and it still is my opening line when I meet a German speaker in Germany. It may sound funny to some, but it surely paved my way to making more friends here. Und ja, ich wohne jetzt in Deutschland! Vielen Dank, Intermed!

name: Shajanie Lomugdang
message: Kalibo is 4 hours away from Iloilo City. But our group decided to take a boarding house and concentrate on learning German with Intermed. Now we live in Germany, and made it to the famous Oktoberfest dressed in dirndl this year! This is life in Germany! It is worth all the efforts we made!
